reason: remove an ambiguity between train-only candidate selection and the requirement to report validation ESS without tuning on validation

clarification.candidate_selection: choose the smallest h using only train structural checks, train distance-1 exposure, train ESS, train far-background retention, train analytical prior error and train mean-weight error
clarification.validation: after h is locked, audit only its preregistered corresponding validation quotas
clarification.validation_failure: a failed validation structural or ESS check rejects the selected candidate; it must not cause selection of a different h
